title: Update gene product of collagen type II trimer

author: pgaudet
Matrisome
body: @pgaudet I got confirmation from Dr. Ricard-Blum that heterotrimers exist between the gene product of COL2A1 and the gene product of COL11A1 and COL11A2 to form a functional molecular composed of the following chains: α1(XI) α2(XI) α1(IIA). Here is a reference: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/24113490/ (PMID: 24113490).
